adjudication_summary: Worker-6 re-review recovered source-supported Table 2 MIC rows and text-level hemolysis/anticancer values, reconciled linked database rows with explicit source conflicts, and closed the prior targeted rework without hiding database/source cautions.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP hybrid MIC and anticancer rows are source verified; DRAMP21453/dbAMP_16316 comparator-column and sequence conflicts are preserved as source_conflict; literature links are source verified.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Primary XML/PDF Table 2 supports four hybrid MIC rows and four melittin comparator rows; result text supports hemolysis threshold and SMMC-7721 percent inhibition.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Only computational/design and assay-scope statements are retained; no direct mechanism assay is promoted.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DRAMP21453 is retained as source_conflict because source methods support the AGP sequence and Table 2 separates hybrid from melittin comparator values.
Primary source supports a no-hemolysis threshold through 45 µmol/L but not the DBAASP exact 0% at 40 µM row.

Introduction contains a no-AGP artificial peptide parenthetical, while methods give the synthesized AGP-containing designed sequence; final identity keeps conflict cautions rather than normalizing silently.

Local landed supplementary landing-*.bin files were checked with file/rg and are HTML landing/article/support/ad assets, not true supplementary data tables; activity blockers were recoverable from XML/PDF.
Table 2 comparator values are retained to explain linked database conflicts but are not treated as hybrid-peptide MIC values.
The paper has MIC/hemolysis/MTT activity evidence and computational structure predictions, but no direct mechanistic assay.
